problems.title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
problems.notes: the 'hello world' of tree recursion — every other DFS problem below is a variation on this shape

problems.title: Path Sum
problems.notes: root-to-leaf recursion carrying a running sum; the base case (leaf check) is where people slip up

problems.title: Diameter of Binary Tree
problems.notes: classic 'return height, update a global max on the way back up' combo — the template for path-sum-style hards later

problems.title: Path Sum II
problems.notes: same as Path Sum but collect all paths — append on the way down, pop on the way back up (backtracking the path list)

problems.title: Validate Binary Search Tree
problems.notes: pass down a (low, high) bound at every node — comparing only to the immediate parent is the classic bug

problems.title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree
problems.notes: post-order DFS returning 'found p / found q / found both' up the call stack — no parent pointers needed

problems.title: Construct Binary Tree from Preorder and Inorder Traversal
problems.notes: preorder's first element is always the root; inorder splits it into left/right — precompute an index map for O(n)

problems.title: Surrounded Regions
problems.notes: DFS from the border inward to mark safe cells first, then flip everything untouched — inverted flood-fill thinking

problems.title: Binary Tree Maximum Path Sum
problems.notes: each node returns its best downward-only path for the parent, but the global answer can bend through both children

problems.title: Longest Increasing Path in a Matrix
problems.notes: DFS + memoization turns an exponential search into O(mn) — the grid is a DAG because values strictly increase
